orca orchestration run-use

Usage: orca orchestration run-use --id <run_id> [--from <handle>] [--takeover-legacy] [--json]

Bind this coordinator terminal to an existing Run

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code
  --environment
  --id <id>             Identifier for a target item or permission
  --from
  --takeover-legacy
  --retry-request

Notes:
  --takeover-legacy must run in the live coordinator agent terminal it binds; it preserves existing worker assignments.
